001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.Location;
004import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
005
006import java.util.UUID;
007
008/**
009 * Supplies bot opponents to ZonePractice Pro. Register it with {@link BotRegistry#register}.
010 * The core calls every method on the main thread.
011 */
012public interface BotProvider {
013
014    /**
015     * Unique id, lowercase [a-z0-9-], 1-32 characters, e.g. "zpp-bots".
016     * @return The id, never null
017     */
018    String getId();
019
020    /**
021     * @return true if bots can be spawned right now
022     */
023    boolean isAvailable();
024
025    /**
026     * Why the provider is unavailable, for the console and admins.
027     * @return The reason, or null if available
028     */
029    String getUnavailableReason();
030
031    /**
032     * Options used when no player choice exists, for example from staff commands.
033     * @return The options, never null
034     */
035    BotOptions getDefaultOptions();
036
037    /**
038     * Command without the slash that lets a player choose new options, e.g. "botpractice".
039     * The result message after a bot match offers it, and offers it with the argument {@code rematch},
040     * which should start {@link BotRegistry#getLastSetup(org.bukkit.entity.Player)} again.
041     * @return The command, never null; lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, at most 32 characters
042     */
043    String getSetupCommand();
044
045    /**
046     * Whether bots can fight with this kit item. A ladder whose kit holds an unsupported item cannot host bot matches.
047     * @param item A non-air kit item, a copy the provider may inspect but not keep
048     * @return true if the bot can use the item
049     */
050    boolean isSupportedItem(ItemStack item);
051
052    /**
053     * Spawn a paused bot body. The core has already reserved {@code entityId} as a bot identity.
054     * @param entityId The UUID the body must use
055     * @param location The spawn location, inside a loaded arena
056     * @param options The options chosen for this match
057     * @return The spawned opponent
058     * @throws RuntimeException If spawning fails; nothing may be left behind
059     */
060    BotOpponent spawn(UUID entityId, Location location, BotOptions options);
061
062    /**
063     * Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
064     * @return The number of bot matches that may run at the same time, 1-64
065     */
066    default int getMaxActiveMatches() {
067        return 16;
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
072     * @return The number of bots alive on the whole server at once, 1-256
073     */
074    default int getMaxTotalBots() {
075        return 32;
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
080     * @return The number of bots in one match, 1 to {@code 2 * BotSetup.MAX_TEAM_SIZE - 1}
081     */
082    default int getMaxBotsPerMatch() {
083        return 2 * BotSetup.MAX_TEAM_SIZE - 1;
084    }
085
086    /**
087     * Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
088     * @return The ticks a match may take to start, 20-1200
089     */
090    default int getStartTimeoutTicks() {
091        return 200;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * Limits the host applies; providers usually read them from their own config.
096     * @return The longest live match in seconds before it ends as a timeout, 30-3600
097     */
098    default int getMaxMatchDurationSeconds() {
099        return 600;
100    }
101
102}
